exclusions.name: Other village officials or staff
exclusions.why_safe: The ordinance adoption requires only council member votes; other officials have no role in the vote outcome.

exclusions.name: Public input or lobbying
exclusions.why_safe: Council members have stated their positions publicly; public input could theoretically change votes, but there is no evidence of any such change occurring before the cutoff.

exclusions.name: Legal challenges or procedural errors
exclusions.why_safe: The question is about adoption at the session; legal challenges after adoption are irrelevant to whether adoption occurs.

uncertainties.meaning: Whether the vote actually takes place at the 8 September session is uncertain because it depends on the session being held and the item not being postponed. The session is scheduled, but unforeseen events could cancel it. Also, under council rules, the sponsor (Okonkwo) could move postponement; her current intention is to proceed, but she could change her mind.
Whether the regular session on 8 September 2026 actually occurs is uncertain due to potential cancellations (e.g., weather, emergency, lack of quorum).
Whether the sponsor or another member moves to postpone the item is uncertain. Okonkwo currently wants final action, but could change her mind.
Whether at least three members are physically present is uncertain. Bianchi has filed an absence, so at most four may attend. If only three attend, quorum is met; if fewer, not.
Whether Okonkwo will be physically present is uncertain; she has not indicated otherwise, but no firm commitment.
Whether Tran will be physically present is uncertain; no statement about attendance.
Whether Delgado will be physically present is uncertain; no statement about attendance.
Whether Pryce will be physically present is uncertain; no statement about attendance.
Bianchi has filed an absence notice, so it is highly likely she will not be present, but it is uncertain whether she might change plans or attend despite the notice.

Whether at least three members vote yes is uncertain because it depends on the votes of those present. Known positions: Okonkwo yes, Tran yes, Delgado no, Pryce no, Bianchi absent (likely). So at most two yes votes are certain; a third yes would require either Bianchi attending and voting yes (unlikely) or one of the opponents changing their vote.
Okonkwo has stated support, but could change her vote.
Tran has stated support, but could change his vote.
Delgado has stated opposition, but could change her vote.
Pryce has stated opposition, but could change his vote.
Bianchi is likely absent, but if present, she has supported the ordinance and would likely vote yes.
